name: National Scheme of Incentive to Girls for Secondary Education
department: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education
target_group: Eligible girls continuing secondary education, especially from specified target groups under scheme rules
eligibility: Eligibility follows the current NSIGSE guidelines and qualifying school/student conditions.
benefits: Financial incentive intended to encourage girls to continue secondary education.
documents: Bank/post office account details as required
application_process: Apply/receive through the government education system/portal as directed by the current scheme guidelines.
source: Ministry of Education / Government of India
